text:
Two small corn cob slices, each about 3 cm in diameter and 1.5 cm thick. Corn on the cob has roughly 0.86–0.96 kcal/g, but the cob itself is inedible. Each slice weighs about 20 g, so together they come to about 40 g. At roughly 0.95 kcal/g that is about 38 kcal. Part of that mass is cob, so I'll lower the estimate a little.
